sources.entry: MarkText - Next generation markdown editor, running on platforms of MacOS Windows and Linux. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/marktext/marktext) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Mark Text - Realtime preview markdown editor for macOS Windows and Linux.

summary.one_liner: MarkText is an open-source, realtime-preview markdown editor for Linux, macOS and Windows, focused on speed and usability.
summary.what_it_does: MarkText provides a WYSIWYG-style realtime preview with a minimal, distraction-free writing interface. It supports the CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown specs and selectively supports Pandoc markdown. Markdown extensions include math expressions (KaTeX), front matter and emojis, plus inline style shortcuts. Documents can be exported as HTML or PDF, and the editor offers several themes (such as Cadmium Light and Material Dark) and editing modes (Source Code, Typewriter, Focus). It can also paste images directly from the clipboard.
use_cases: write markdown notes with live preview
edit markdown documents on Mac, Windows or Linux
export markdown to PDF or HTML
how_to_run: Or download installers from the release page
Linux: follow the Linux installation instructions in the project docs
To build from source, see the build instructions in the development documentation
notable: Supports CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown, with selective Pandoc support
Source Code, Typewriter and Focus editing modes
Installable via Homebrew, Chocolatey and Winget
caveats: macOS build requires macOS 13 (Ventura) or later
Pandoc markdown support is only selective
